fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Innocent combination table (47 x 132): for Innocent type <id> combined with the Innocent type of column j (columns ordered like the rows), the resulting Innocent type id. E.g. Dietician(1)+Master(2) -> 11 Muscleman; stat innocents 1-8 x 1-8 give the 11-17 tier, 61-75 rows are identity (no transformation), 28 always stays 28.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: Innocent type id (HABIT.dat innocent id, u32 at +4: 1 Dietician, 2 Master ... 75)

fields.name: with_0
fields.desc: resulting Innocent type id when combined with type 0 (Jobless); 0 = no result. Columns follow the row-id order 0..8, 11..17, 21..28, 41..47, 51..53, 61..68, 71..75
